title: The challenge
text: In a block office in Rampur, a dashboard turns red: Class 3 subtraction has fallen eighteen points. And then… nothing happens. Officers have data, but every system stops at the alert. No owner, no deadline, no proof, and no one checks whether children learned more.

title: Our answer
text: Karyavahi turns every learning drop into a case: flag, diagnose, plan, approve, act, verify. And a case closes only when the next assessment shows children learned more.

title: The officer's view
text: The block officer starts on a command centre, not a spreadsheet: their own area on a real map, and what needs them today. Anything is one search away, or they can just ask Claude. Here is the case: the drop, the schools driving it, and the conditions behind it. Claude explains it in plain words, and every figure it writes is checked against the records. It suggests a plan from an evidence library, with real costs. But the officer decides, and a second officer approves, in one tap. Every task gets an owner and a deadline.

title: Easy for people in the field
text: For headmasters and field staff, it works the way they already work. It opens in Hindi. They can listen to their day instead of reading it, and speak a note instead of typing. No signal? Proof is saved on the phone, and sent when the network returns, with the location checked. And they don't even need the app: on WhatsApp, tasks arrive, a reply marks them done, and a photo becomes proof.

title: Proof, then results
text: Proof is checked by someone other than the person who did the work. When the next round arrives, Karyavahi compares plan schools with similar schools, and asks: did it work? If not, the case reopens. And the Action Taken Report writes itself.

title: Why you can trust it
text: Claude only drafts and explains, from records the user is allowed to see, always cited. The decisions are made by people, and every change goes into a tamper-evident audit trail. Schools, costs and district figures come from real public data. And it's tested end to end: every page, every role.
